capabilities: Render a 3D force-directed graph of vault links
Color and group notes by AI-generated topic clusters with boundary boxes and labels
Tune cluster physics with live sliders for radius, force strength, and separation
Surface gap insights between clusters and highlight them in the graph
Run an optional local MCP server so AI tools can query the graph and drive highlights
disambiguation: The plugin calls no AI backend itself; it renders clustering from an analysis.json file that an external AI assistant generates.
extras: Flagged as not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Author says it is built for personal use with rough edges and requires manual installation. Privacy section: no network requests; the optional MCP server only listens on localhost and is off by default.
intentEvidence: Forked from Obsidian 3D Graph by Alexander Weichart, extended with:
problem: Obsidian's graph view is flat and 2D and offers no clustering or analysis of structural gaps between topics in a vault.
